Start with the expanded examples. Open further examples for options and alternative R approaches.

arima

ARIMA model

Stata 

arima y, ar(1/2)

R stats 

stats::arima(data$y, order = c(2, 0, 0), method = "ML")

Differs from Stata Stationary AR(2) fitted by maximum likelihood. Use the same regular time series and sample; initialization and optimizer details can differ. R intercept is the process mean, so convert an AR-equation constant before comparing.

Stata reference · R reference

carryforward

Carry the last observed value forward

Stata 

carryforward x, replace

R tidyr 

tidyr::fill(data, x, .direction = "down")

Differs from Stata group_by(data, id) first to fill within each panel unit. fill() crosses panel boundaries unless grouped first; group_by(id) is needed for within-unit carryforward.

Stata reference · R reference

d.

First difference within each panel

Stata 

generate d_x = D.x

R tidystata 

mutate(data, d_x = stata_diff(x, time = year), .by = id)

stata_diff(x, 2, time = year) is D2.x, the difference of differences.

Stata reference · R reference

f.

Lead within each panel

Stata 

generate lead_x = F.x

R tidystata 

mutate(data, lead_x = stata_lead(x, time = year), .by = id)

Gaps in year give missing values, as in Stata.

Stata reference · R reference

l.

Lag within each panel

Stata 

generate lag_x = L.x

R tidystata 

mutate(data, lag_x = stata_lag(x, time = year), .by = id)

Like Stata, gaps in year give missing values; dplyr::lag() shifts rows instead. Use stata_lag(x, 2, time = year) for L2.x and unit = "month" for monthly dates.

Stata reference · R reference

1 more examples and alternatives

Two-period lag within each panel

Stata 

generate lag2_x = L2.x

R tidystata 

dplyr::mutate(data, lag2_x = tidystata::stata_lag(x, 2, time = year), .by = id)

Differs from Stata Shifts two time units within id and returns missing across gaps, matching L2.x; dplyr lag would shift observed rows.

Stata reference · R reference

tsfill

Add rows for missing time points

Stata 

tsfill

R tsibble 

tsibble::fill_gaps(ts_data)

Differs from Stata fill_gaps() fills each key's observed range by default; choose .full explicitly for common panel bounds and ensure the tsibble interval matches the Stata delta.

Stata reference · R reference

tsline

Time-series line plot

Stata 

tsline y

R ggplot2 

ggplot(data, aes(year, y)) + geom_line()

Stata reference · R reference

tsset

Declare time-series data

Stata 

tsset year

R tsibble 

tsibble::as_tsibble(data, index = year)

Stata reference · R reference

xtline

One line plot per panel unit

Stata 

xtline y

R ggplot2 

ggplot(data, aes(year, y)) + geom_line() + facet_wrap(~id)

aes(group = id) without facets draws all units in one plot, like the overlay option.

Stata reference · R reference

xtset

Declare panel data

Stata 

xtset id year

R tsibble 

tsibble::as_tsibble(data, key = id, index = year)

tidystata needs no declaration: stata_lag(x, time = year) with .by = id, and fixest takes panel.id = ~id + year.
